title: Build interactive assumptions panel
description: Create slider and number input controls for all user-adjustable variables: DC (75000), CMT (20), Days (4), Weeks (48), Risk (1/20000), VAD (1/100000), CAD (2/100000), Pop (330000000). Use Svelte reactivity for real-time recalculation.

title: Build Chart.js visualization comparing claimed vs actual dissections
description: Side-by-side bar chart comparing: estimated dissections from manipulation (DC*CMT*Days*Weeks*Risk) vs total VAD, CAD, and CeAD prevalence (incidence*Pop). Responsive and animated.

title: Stroke Risk Visualization Website
description: Build an interactive SvelteKit website comparing claimed vs estimated stroke risk from cervical manipulation. Users can adjust assumptions (DC, CMT, Days, Weeks, Risk, VAD, CAD, Pop) via sliders and see real-time Chart.js visualizations.
